# FDG3077

> DO use PascalCasing in field names.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.6.4 Naming Fields.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE1006
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

IDE1006 checks the first letter through the visible-field naming rule configured by FDGA052. The field-naming guidelines cover public and protected static fields; internal and private fields follow FDGA054 and FDGA055, and public or protected instance fields are not allowed (chapter 5).

## From the book

```csharp
public class String {
   public static readonly string Empty = "";
}
public struct UInt32 {
   public const MinValue = 0;
}
```
